Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background texture for a 2D side-view fantasy mobile tower battle game. Generate a complete brand-new landscape illustration, 1536x1024. Style: richly hand-painted stylized fantasy environment, crisp dark ink-like outlines, layered stone textures, painterly restrained highlights, readable silhouettes, polished indie game art. Flat front elevation with only shallow depth, not isometric, not overhead and not a corridor receding into a distant vanishing point. The environment spans the full image with no border. Keep the central area relatively low contrast and free of foreground obstructions so animated combat units can be drawn in front. One coherent environment only, no collage. No characters, no monsters, no readable writing, no UI, no logo, no watermark.
Scene: an underground bioluminescent mushroom grotto. Enormous purple and turquoise mushroom caps arch around the sides; smaller luminous fungi grow in rocky niches, stalactites hang overhead, blue-green crystals are embedded sparsely in the rugged cave walls. A broad empty horizontal stone shelf runs along the bottom. Cool violet rock with cyan bioluminescent rim light, mysterious and calm. Distinct organic cave geology, absolutely no castle arches or masonry hall.
